comment: Whether customers can sign up to be emailed when a product's price changes.
modal: When **Yes**, a price-change alert sign-up appears on product pages so customers can be emailed when the price changes; **No** removes it. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether customers can sign up to be emailed when an out-of-stock product is available again.
modal: When **Yes**, an in-stock alert sign-up appears on product pages so customers can be notified when the item returns to stock; **No** removes it. Can differ per website.

comment: Which store email identity product alert emails are sent from.
modal: Selects the sender identity used for product alert emails — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2) configured under *General → Store Email Addresses*. Can differ per store view.

comment: How often the scheduled job that sends product alert emails runs.
modal: Sets the schedule for the product-alert cron job that sends pending price and stock notifications. Choose from the available frequency options.

comment: The time of day the product alert cron job runs.
modal: The start time (hour, minute, second) at which the product-alert cron job runs on its configured frequency.

comment: The email address notified if the product alert cron job fails.
modal: The recipient address for error notifications raised when the product-alert cron job cannot complete. Leave empty to send no error email.

comment: Which store email identity product alert error emails are sent from.
modal: Selects the sender identity for product-alert error notifications — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities configured under *General → Store Email Addresses*.
